title: Security and defence lexicon (in the media)

blocks.text: Security and defence occupy part of the Arab news daily: ministries and armed forces, cooperation agreements, border crises, ceasefires, attacks and investigations. To understand these news and report them accurately, a specific vocabulary is needed, but above all caution is needed: the budgets of victims change from hour to hour, sources are often not verifiable, and the choice of a word (the "fighter," the "militian" or "terrorist") often reveals the point of view of those who write. In this unit you learn the vocabulary of the security institutions and the news about them, the prepositions of cause and circumstance typical of the chronicle, the way to report uncertain budgets and figures and the rules to bring back the words connotationed without making them own. The vocabulary is that of the newspapers: no technical or operational details. Three weeks, no trace of variety in parallel.

condition ( ⁧إِثْرَ⁩ , ⁧جَرَّاءَ⁩ , ⁧عَلَى خَلْفِيَّةِ⁩ …);
3. reporting uncertain budgets and figures with the right formulas ( ⁧حَصِيلَة⁩ , ⁧مَا لَا يَقِلُّ عَنْ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ يَتَسَنَّ التَّحَقُّقُ⁩ …);
4. recognize the words and bring them back to the source;
5. read a news report of 330 words on these topics at least 80 words per minute.

Exercise 9. a) Between the Government and the Mountain Front (Mountains) from midnight on Sunday; After three months of clashes in the northern provinces, which according to the UN caused more than one hundred thousand displaced persons. After a round of indirect talks hosted by a neighbouring country, with the foreign minister of that country as mediator. The agreement provides for: stop to hostilities; withdrawal of both sides five kilometres from the front lines; buffer zone with international observers; political negotiations within one month. The mediator speaks of successful test and limited accidents; the army accuses armed elements of firing on its station; The Front says that government forces have not yet withdrawn from two villages. The versions are not verifiable because the observer mission has not yet arrived. Factors: The ability of the two parties to control their men on the ground and the guarantees of international actors (two previous agreements collapsed in a few weeks). Cooperation: Memorandum on information exchange, coordination of research and rescue, training of coastguards; annual joint exercises. Limits: mistrust between the apparatuses; different laws on data protection; Southern countries complain that cooperation follows the priorities of the north (limit migration), while they need support to monitor the coasts and combat illegal fishing. Rescue: International law obliges every ship to help those in danger, but disputes over the responsibility of landing sometimes delay the arrival on the ground of survivors. Conclusion (some researchers): moving from the logic of security to that of partnership.
